residual_geometry.formula: For two reversed binary mappings, chosen first native key iff (bA-bB)_0-(bA-bB)_1+(h0-h1) dot (wA-wB) >= 0. Hidden h is RMS-normalized. Float64 sign replay agrees with saved decisions.
residual_geometry.caution: Descriptive geometry and exact decision identity, not evidence that fitting more parameters or changing representations would improve held-out accuracy.

limitations: All 112 inputs were already exposed development; dev was used for checkpoint selection.
Old direct explicitly defines positive as whole-hypothesis support and negative as not fully supported; new choice prompt uses generic native-key meanings.
Additional prompt wording, code table serialization, and vLLM/HF inference backend differ; this is not an isolated causal test of RULE.
